# Satismeter

SatisMeter is a customer feedback platform that enables businesses to collect and analyze user feedback through targeted surveys.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/satismeter/.

## Actions

- **Embed Survey** (read-only): Generate a javascript snippet to embed a satismeter survey.
- **Get Unsubscribed Emails** (read-only): Retrieve list of unsubscribed emails for a project.
- **List Surveys** (read-only): List surveys (campaigns) in a project.
- **List Users** (read-only): List users in a project.
- **Update Unsubscribed Emails**: Update the list of unsubscribed emails for a project.
